winui.Description: Isolate tests from platform dependencies
winui.Do: Interface wrappers around WinRT APIs
winui.Don't: Direct WinRT API calls in testable code

winui.Description: Built-in numeric entry with validation formatting and spin buttons
winui.Do: NumberBox with Minimum Maximum and SpinButtonPlacementMode
winui.Don't: TextBox with manual numeric parsing and validation
winui.Code Good: <NumberBox Value="{x:Bind Quantity, Mode=TwoWay}" Minimum="0" Maximum="100" SpinButtonPlacementMode="Inline"/>
winui.Code Bad: TextBox with regex validation for numbers

winui.Description: Expandable content area with header for progressive disclosure
winui.Do: Expander for settings groups and optional content
winui.Code Bad: Button toggling StackPanel.Visibility for collapsible content

winui.Guideline: Use ProgressRing and ProgressBar for loading
winui.Description: Built-in loading indicators for determinate and indeterminate states
winui.Do: ProgressRing for indeterminate and ProgressBar for determinate progress
winui.Don't: Custom spinning animation or text-based loading indicators

winui.Description: Adapt UI layout to window size using adaptive triggers
winui.Do: AdaptiveTrigger with MinWindowWidth for responsive breakpoints
winui.Don't: Fixed layouts that break at different window sizes
winui.Code Bad: Fixed two-column layout at all window sizes

winui.Description: WinUI 3 apps receive activation events for URI and notification launches
winui.Do: Check LaunchActivatedEventArgs in OnLaunched for activation context
winui.Don't: Ignoring activation arguments losing deep link context
winui.Code Good: protected override void OnLaunched(LaunchActivatedEventArgs args) { if (args.Arguments.Contains("settings")) NavigateToSettings(); }
winui.Code Bad: Empty OnLaunched ignoring all activation parameters

winui.Description: Prevent multiple app windows competing for resources
winui.Do: AppInstance.FindOrRegisterForKey for single-instance enforcement
winui.Code Good: var instance = AppInstance.FindOrRegisterForKey("main"); if (!instance.IsCurrent) { await instance.RedirectActivationToAsync(args); }
winui.Code Bad: No instance management allowing duplicate windows

winui.Description: Persist UI state across app restarts for continuity (ApplicationData APIs require packaged apps; unpackaged apps must use file IO or registry)
winui.Do: Save state to local settings on window close or navigation
winui.Don't: Losing user context on every restart
winui.Code Bad: No state persistence losing navigation position on restart

winui.Guideline: Choose Mica vs Acrylic by surface lifetime
winui.Description: Mica is for long-lived primary surfaces like main windows; Acrylic is for transient light-dismiss surfaces like flyouts and context menus
winui.Do: Mica on root window backgrounds and Acrylic on flyouts and overlays
winui.Don't: Acrylic on the main window or Mica on transient flyouts
winui.Code Bad: Acrylic on every Window background causing battery and perf cost

winui.Description: WinUI 3 1.3+ exposes Window.SystemBackdrop with MicaBackdrop and DesktopAcrylicBackdrop classes replacing manual MicaController plumbing
winui.Do: Window.SystemBackdrop in XAML or code
winui.Don't: Hand-rolled MicaController wiring when SystemBackdrop API is available

winui.Guideline: Open secondary windows with new Window
winui.Description: WinUI 3 supports multiple top-level windows; each Window owns an AppWindow accessible via Window.AppWindow for size and position control
winui.Do: new Window().Activate() for secondary windows tracking them in App state
winui.Don't: Faking multi-window via main-window content swaps or ContentDialog
winui.Code Bad: MainWindow.Content = new SettingsView(); when a separate window is needed

winui.Guideline: Extend client area into the title bar
winui.Description: Use Window.ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar with SetTitleBar to host custom XAML in the chrome while preserving caption buttons
winui.Do: ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar=true plus SetTitleBar(element) for custom drag region
winui.Don't: Hardcoded chrome height or custom caption buttons that break with theme and size changes
winui.Code Bad: Padding="0,32,0,0" to reserve space without SetTitleBar leaves window non-draggable

winui.Description: Map Ctrl/Alt/Shift combinations to commands using KeyboardAccelerator on UIElement
winui.Do: KeyboardAccelerator with Modifiers and Key on relevant controls

winui.Description: Share styles and brushes via App.xaml MergedDictionaries instead of duplicating per page
winui.Do: MergedDictionaries in App.xaml for shared styles brushes and colors
winui.Don't: Duplicating SolidColorBrush definitions on every page
winui.Code Bad: SolidColorBrush Color hardcoded inline on every page

winui.Description: AsyncRelayCommand exposes IsRunning and supports cancellation for IO bound work
winui.Do: [RelayCommand] on async Task method or AsyncRelayCommand for IO work
winui.Don't: async void event handlers or fire-and-forget Task.Run from button click
winui.Code Good: [RelayCommand] private async Task LoadAsync(CancellationToken ct) { Items = await _service.FetchAsync(ct); }
winui.Code Bad: private async void Button_Click(object s, RoutedEventArgs e) { await LoadAsync(); }

winui.Description: Microsoft.Extensions.Logging ILogger<T> with DI for structured leveled logs
winui.Do: ILogger<T> injected via constructor for diagnostic logging
winui.Don't: Debug.WriteLine or Console.WriteLine for app diagnostics
winui.Code Good: public MainViewModel(ILogger<MainViewModel> logger) { _logger = logger; } _logger.LogInformation("Loaded {Count} items", count);

avalonia.Description: Avalonia has its own XAML namespace not WPF

avalonia.Code Bad: <Window xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation">

avalonia.Description: Target control states with colon syntax

avalonia.Description: Native menu bar on macOS and desktop

avalonia.Description: UI updates on collection changes
avalonia.Do: ObservableCollection<T> for bound collections

avalonia.Description: Element-to-element binding with # syntax
avalonia.Do: #ElementName.Property for cross-element binding

avalonia.Description: Transform data for display
avalonia.Do: FuncValueConverter for simple inline conversions

avalonia.Description: Isolate platform code behind abstractions
avalonia.Do: Interface + platform implementation pattern

avalonia.Description: Platform-agnostic resource loading
avalonia.Do: avares:// URI scheme for embedded resources

avalonia.Description: Only render visible items

avalonia.Description: Full keyboard operability

avalonia.Description: Controls convey meaning to assistive tech

avalonia.Don't: Window per page or nested Windows

avalonia.Description: Avalonia supports declarative animations in XAML and code

avalonia.Description: Automatic animation when property values change

avalonia.Guideline: Use compiled bindings and TrimmerRoots.xml for PublishAot
avalonia.Description: Avalonia 11+ supports Native AOT for self-contained desktop deployments; XAML reflection paths must use compiled bindings or be preserved via TrimmerRoots so trimming does not strip them
avalonia.Do: x:CompileBindings=True on every view plus TrimmerRoots.xml for runtime-resolved types
avalonia.Don't: PublishAot with reflection-based {Binding} markup or trimming without checking warnings

avalonia.Guideline: Marshal cross-thread work to the UI thread
avalonia.Description: Avalonia controls and bound properties are not thread-safe and touching them off the UI thread throws InvalidOperationException
avalonia.Do: Dispatcher.UIThread.Post or InvokeAsync to bounce work back to the UI thread
avalonia.Don't: Direct property writes from Task.Run or background threads
avalonia.Code Bad: Task.Run(() => { Status = "Done"; }); // throws Call from invalid thread

avalonia.Guideline: Use AsyncRelayCommand or ReactiveCommand for async work
avalonia.Description: Async-aware commands disable themselves while running and surface CancellationToken so users cannot double-invoke a long operation

avalonia.Don't: async void event handlers or fire-and-forget Task.Run from a click handler

avalonia.Guideline: Use TrayIcon for system tray icon

avalonia.Guideline: Use OnPlatform and OnFormFactor markup for per-OS values
